subject.title: Reduce remote node bin probe churn

question: What cache and retry timing should OpenClaw use for macOS remote skill-bin probes once this is ported to the active runtime?
rationale: The proposed TTL/backoff changes affect how quickly remote skill availability reflects node environment changes and how long retries can be suppressed after transient failures.

options.title: Port With Bounded Proven Timing
options.body: Port the fix to `src/skills/runtime/remote.*`, require snapshot invalidation on cache restore, and tune cache/backoff windows with real macOS proof before merge.

options.title: Accept Current Timing Policy
options.body: Keep the 24-hour success TTL and 1h-to-24h failure backoff if maintainers intentionally accept the stale-availability tradeoff.

options.title: Pause For Replacement PR
options.body: Close or pause this stale branch after asking for a fresh narrow PR that credits the cache/backoff idea and targets the active runtime.

recommendation.title: Port With Bounded Proven Timing
recommendation.body: Port the fix to `src/skills/runtime/remote.*`, require snapshot invalidation on cache restore, and tune cache/backoff windows with real macOS proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The timing choice spans macOS node exec, remote skills, and gateway readiness behavior where steipete has the strongest history signal and current assignment.
